# Memdeklaro - Self-Declaration of Identity

> Memdeklaro is an ethical alternative to centralized ID. Free to use, open source and zero third parties. Unlike traditional centralized ID cards, Memdeklaro is self-declared and self-printed by the user themselves. Memdeklaro is for everyone and does not require permission from third parties.

## Quick Start

1. Use the free generator at https://memdeklaro.org or download the open source template from https://github.com/memdeklaro
2. Add your self-chosen name, birth date, photo and signature
3. Print it out as a business card or CR-80 plastic card or use digitally
